None of the sellers' declared flex is meaningfully above nameplate, so I challenged no commitments. PVB_17 (5454.6 vs 5455 kW), PVB_37 (2434.7 vs 2435 kW) and PVB_32 (3274.8 vs 3275 kW) are all at or below nameplate. PVB_50 declares 6837.4 kW against a 6837 kW nameplate, a 0.4 kW gap that looks like rounding rather than a false claim, so I left its commitment (ID 4) unchallenged. If you want strict "any excess" enforcement, I can challenge it, but that carries bond risk.
